Aisha: Quick sync 2: need to finalize pilot slate + acceptance checklist today so outreach goes Mon.
Sam: +1. Proposed hard limits: 8 partner slots, 4-week pilot, max 2 deep integrations.
Neil: Metrics to track: latency SLO adherence, error rate <1%, and primary-prompt quality regression <5%.
Tara: Require partners to upload 5 representative prompts + baseline outputs before kickoff. That makes weekly diffs reliable.
Josh: Infra note: stagger starts by 1 week to avoid KV/batching contention. Can support 8 if staggered.
Priya: Legal asks: KMS/data handling confirmed and an anonymization opt-out clause. Also no PHI without review.
Mina: Outreach email snippet: "Hi <Partner>, we'd love your team to try a short 4-week pilot to shape Redwood inference defaults. Includes priority tuning, joint metrics, and weekly 30m syncs. Interested?"
Aisha: Draft acceptance checklist: signed pilot agreement, 5 prompts + baselines uploaded, kickoff sessions scheduled, success metrics agreed (1 quant + 2 qual), weekly contact, data/KMS ack.
Sam: I'll run scoring (impact, engineering fit, data readiness, legal friction) and return top 8 + 2 alternates.
Josh: I'll publish a capacity calendar and per-partner route + token cost dashboard.
Neil: I'll wire the weekly dashboard and a 2-week midpoint review.
Priya: I'll add the anonymization/public-eval permission and opt-out language to the agreement.
CS-bot: Reminder: /create-pilot-kickoff <partner> to auto-create calendar stub.
Aisha: If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll publish invites and start staggered scheduling. Please react :thumbsup: if you're good.
